statement: James wrote, opening the 2026-09-05 session: "Autonomously, I give you full authority for this run: run as many individual runs as you need. That means trial runs, adversarial reviews, code reviews, etc." and, at 02:48 MST after the council's design was reported in progress: "Don't block on human (aka me). I want you to run this all the way through to the end. You have the authority to do whatever you need. I approve, so don't block on waiting for me until this is fully complete, done, and I can analyze the results of the complete run tomorrow morning." This file, written by the council chair on that instruction, authorizes the three-trial canary A (top-words-feature x A1, DEP, M1), a harness check excluded from campaign analysis on the plan whose hash is printed by `clause_campaign.py check` for this declaration.
